title: Missed deliveries causing stockouts and repeated rescheduling
situation: High sentiment drop (-1.5) and 2 VIPs affected by repeated missed dates and stockouts.
hypothesis: Items out of stock after failed delivery

params.reply_en: We missed the delivery window and are sorry for the inconvenience. We are checking stock availability for your items now. If out of stock, we will process a full refund within 24 hours.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن تأخر التوصيل. نعمل حالياً على التحقق من توفر المنتجات. إذا لم تكن متوفرة، سنقوم بإرجاع المبلغ كاملاً خلال 24 ساعة.

actions.why: Address the stockout risk and set expectations for refund if items are unavailable.

params.note: Cluster of 6 customers with repeated missed delivery dates. 2 VIPs. Check if stock is being reserved during failed delivery attempts.

actions.why: Investigate why stock is not reserved or why rescheduling leads to stockouts.

params.title: Missed delivery and stock availability
params.answer_en: If a delivery is missed, we check stock availability. If items are out of stock, we will refund you within 24 hours.
params.answer_ar: إذا تم تفويت موعد التوصيل، نتحقق من توفر المنتجات. إذا لم تكن متوفرة، سنقوم بإرجاع المبلغ خلال 24 ساعة.

actions.why: Standardize the response for missed deliveries that result in stockouts.

reply_en: We missed the delivery window and are sorry for the inconvenience. We are checking stock availability for your items now. If out of stock, we will process a full refund within 24 hours.
reply_ar: نعتذر عن تأخر التوصيل. نعمل حالياً على التحقق من توفر المنتجات. إذا لم تكن متوفرة، سنقوم بإرجاع المبلغ كاملاً خلال 24 ساعة.

reply_other.es: Lo sentimos por el fallo en la entrega. Estamos verificando la disponibilidad de sus artículos. Si no están en stock, procesaremos un reembolso completo en 24 horas.

alternatives.hypothesis: Courier failed to deliver and missed scheduled dates.
alternatives.why: Common cause of missed deliveries, but supervisor rejected this as the primary issue.
Customers mention no updates on the system, suggesting a technical issue.
